# Sunstone House

> Furnished monthly rooms in a shared co-living house in Kenton, North Portland, Oregon (97217). Eleven private furnished rooms. Month-to-month with a 31-day minimum stay, utilities included, no deposit on private contracts through RentRedi. No pets, no smoking.

## Product and services

- [Sunstone House](https://sunstonehousepdx.com/): Furnished private rooms in a shared co-living house for working professionals on medium- and long-term stays — travel nurses, contractors, and relocators. Rooms are fully furnished; guests bring clothes, food, and a laptop.
- Shared kitchen, shared baths, in-house washer/dryer (coin-free, detergent supplied), housekeeping, and on-site management are included with every room.
- [Apply and room details (RentRedi)](https://app.rentredi.com/listingDetails/nP26V74aCEU7MQTvePxpmJXlaKL2): Free prequalification and the application path for direct bookings.

## Pricing

Monthly rent, utilities built in, no deposit (tenants are responsible for any damage). Availability as of November 2, 2026:

- Azurite (Unit C6) — $1,100/mo, floor 2 — open now
- Opal (Unit A2) — $1,200/mo, queen bed, 160 sq ft, floor 2 — open now
- Sapphire (Unit C1) — $1,200/mo, queen bed, 220 sq ft, floor 2 — open now
- Emerald (Unit C2) — $1,300/mo, queen bed, 198 sq ft, floor 2, A/C — booked through November 8, 2026; opens November 9
- Garnet (Unit A4) — $1,100/mo, twin bed, A/C — booked through November 30, 2026; opens December 1
- Kunzite (Unit C5) — $1,100/mo, twin bed, petite room — booked through December 22, 2026; opens December 23
- Coral (Unit A1), Larimar (Unit A3), Lapis (Unit C4), Apatite (Unit A5), Pyrite (Unit C3) — private contract, month-to-month — pricing on request

Availability changes as reservations change; the room cards on the website carry the current reservation end dates.

## FAQ

- What is the minimum stay? 31 days. Rooms are month-to-month after that.
- Is there a deposit? No deposit on private contracts through RentRedi; tenants are responsible for any damage.
- Are utilities included? Yes — utilities are built into the monthly rent.
- Are pets allowed? No pets, and no smoking anywhere on the property.
- Is laundry available? Yes — in-house washer/dryer, coin-free, with detergent supplied. Laundry is not a send-out service.
- What do I need to bring? Clothes, food, and a laptop. Rooms are furnished, and towels, soap, and basics are provided.
- How do I apply? Prequalification through RentRedi is free; the link is on the website. A phone conversation comes first — it is the best way we have found to check fit.
- What are the house quiet hours? 10 pm to 7 am. Business hours are 8 am to 5 pm.

## Testimonials

- Sunstone House is hosted by an Airbnb Superhost; all rooms are also listed on Airbnb with a 30-night minimum.
- A Coral room guest who stayed August 24 to September 26, 2026 left a 5-star Airbnb review praising the house and the host.
- Extended stays are common: a recent Azurite room booking ran five months, and guests regularly extend month-to-month on private contracts.

## Location

- Kenton neighborhood, Portland, OR 97217 (North Portland). The house serves guests working across the Portland metro, including hospital assignments at Providence Portland and OHSU.
- Exact address is provided to confirmed guests; public listings show neighborhood and ZIP only.
